about: A kit for the playbook tests: a picture of a website, and a check of it.

tools.name: paint_picture
tools.title: Paint a picture
tools.asks: a picture of a site, a cover, or art for a post about it
tools.description: Paints a {fact:paintkit.size} picture of a website and writes picture.png, its layers and PAINT.md, which says what is on it. Read PAINT.md first.
tools.hostedDescription: Paints a {fact:paintkit.size} picture of a website and writes picture.png and PAINT.md. A job stops after {limit:job_minutes} here.

length.description: How long each stroke is, like 3.5 or 2s.

marks.description: Marks in seconds, like 1.5,3, or a JSON file of them.

clean.description: Set to false to keep the page's banners.

keep.description: Keep the work files in the system's temporary folder.

timeout_seconds.description: Give up after this many seconds.
timeout_seconds.hostedDescription: Give up after this many seconds. A job stops after {limit:job_minutes} here, so more does not help.

failed: Read why it failed; the {topic} playbook has the fixes.

done: Show {file:picture.png} to the user; its link works for {limit:keep_days}.

tools.name: check_picture
tools.title: Check a picture
tools.asks: a picture checked before it goes out
tools.description: Checks a picture's size and writes CHECK.md with every check.

picture.description: The picture to check, like picture.png.

expect.description: The size it should have, like 1200x630.

passed: Tell the user the picture passed.
check_failed: Read the FAIL lines in {file:CHECK.md} first.
